{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
If you are on a diet, you might want to skip this lesson. Seriously! Otherwise you are about to listen to the most sensual dialogue of this course. Our keywords are: '''qué rico''' – how delicious and '''cuidado''' – caution/be careful. Have the cookies ready!
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0047|A0047: Coffee time]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0106|A0106: Room service]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0116|A0116: Do you want a mint?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Huele bien.'''
| It smells good.
| '''Sí, son mis galletas.'''
| Yes, it's my cookies.
| '''¡Qué rico!'''
| How delicious!
| '''¡Cuidado, están calientes!'''
| Careful, they're hot!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Huele bien.'''
| It smells good.
| '''Sí, son mis galletas.'''
| Yes, it's my cookies.
| '''¡Qué rico!'''
| How delicious!
| '''¡Cuidado, están calientes!'''
| Careful, they're hot!
}}</includeonly>

<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| It smells good. Is it cookies?
| '''Huele bien. ¿Son galletas?'''
| Yes, it's my hot cookies.
| '''Sí, son mis galletas calientes.'''
| Are they hot?
| '''¿Están calientes?'''
| Yes, they are hot. Careful!
| '''Sí, están calientes. ¡Cuidado!'''
| How hot!
| '''¡Qué caliente!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| It smells good. Is it cookies?
| '''Huele bien. ¿Son galletas?'''
| Yes, it's my hot cookies.
| '''Sí, son mis galletas calientes.'''
| Are they hot?
| '''¿Están calientes?'''
| Yes, they are hot. Careful!
| '''Sí, están calientes. ¡Cuidado!'''
| How hot!
| '''¡Qué caliente!'''
}}</includeonly>
